editorial.blurb: Happy Lamb is an affordable, vibrant hot pot destination in Chinatown where you build your own meal from an impressive spread of fresh meats, vegetables, and noodles.
editorial.insiderTip: Add your name to the online waitlist before arriving, as waits are long—but you can explore nearby Chinatown spots while you wait. Pro move: bring a group to maximize the generous meat portions, and ask staff about dietary accommodations since they'll separate broths for vegetarian preferences.
signatureDishes: Sesame balls with red bean paste
